messages:
sara: quick heads-up — I was onboarding mixtral-8k-v2 to the runtime and hit a perf regression + KV thrash. kernel selection fell back to generic_float even though we have a quant profile. paste of profiling + logs below.

sara: ```
model: mixtral-8k-v2
hf_meta: {"num_heads": 32, "kv_dim": 4096, "hidden_size": 8192, "rope_scale": 0.87} 
selected_kernel: generic_float
baseline_p95_ms: 68
current_p95_ms: 112
kv_evictions_per_sec: 4.2
batcher_avg_wait_ms: 18
notes: kernel_picker -> fell back because head_dim mismatch detected during hfparse fallback
```

sara: logs show: 
```
WARNING runtime.hfparse: safetensors metadata missing 'axes' -> inferring layout
INFO runtime.kernel_picker: head_dim computed 128 but model metadata implies 256 -> fallback to generic
ERROR batcher.dispatch: kv-stride mismatch for cached entries, forcing eviction window
```

ben: can you paste the exact HF config file you pulled from hub? i want to see num_heads/hidden_size values and any custom attributes.

sara: here it is: ```
{"architectures": ["MixtralForCausalLM"], "hidden_size": 8192, "num_attention_heads": 32, "rotary_pct": 1.0, "rope_scale": 0.87, "kv_dim": 4096} 
```

ben: hmm hfparse is mapping num_attention_heads -> num_heads fine. but older safetensors conversions sometimes add a separate axes mapping or omit per-head dims. if head_dim calc = hidden_size / num_heads = 256 then where did 128 come from in the log?

khoa: maybe we hit a legacy converter path that kept an older 'hidden_size' override or a dtype quantization meta entry that changed expected dims. do we have the safetensors header blob for this file?

sara: i grabbed it, header excerpt: ```
{"metadata": {}, "shapes": [["transformer.wq.weight", 8192, 8192], ["transformer.kv.weight", 4096, 8192]] }
```

maria: empty metadata is the smoking gun. without axes/heads info hfparse falls back to heuristics and sometimes picks per-tensor kv layout incorrectly. we've seen similar with qwen variants — it causes the kernel selector to choose kernels that assume different KV stride, then KV cache writes become misaligned -> evictions.

jordan: quick repro idea: run the kernel microbench comparing generic_float vs head-optimized kernels with same model matrix shapes. command: `python -m bench.kernel_select --model mixtral-8k-v2 --kernels all --iters 200 --batch 1 --seq 1024`

khoa: also run `python tools/validate_safetensors.py --file /path/to/model.safetensors` which will fail early if axes missing or shapes ambiguous. we should wire that into onboarding.

ben: for immediate mitigation, can we force kernel_picker to prefer head-aware kernels when head_dim == hidden_size/num_heads (and add a safety check on kv_dim)? that should avoid fallback to generic_float in many cases. but we need to make sure rope_scale is considered — some kernels expect scaled RoPE.

sara: i tried a patch on my local runtime where kernel_picker checks computed_head_dim against kv_dim/num_heads and prefers head_optimized if close. perf improved: p95 -> 74ms, kv_evictions/sec -> 0.3. still need CI tests.

maria: sounds good. long term we should: 1) enforce safetensors metadata in conversion script (fail onboarding if axes missing), 2) add a lint that warns on rope_scale != 1.0 and surfaces kernel compatibility, 3) add a small microbench battery to onboarding to detect kernel fallbacks.

jordan: i'll add the microbench to the onboarding pipeline. can we also add an automated check that runs `kernel_picker` offline and records selected_kernel; if it picks generic for a model with expected head_optimized profile, fail the job.

khoa: agree. small implementation note: when switching kernel preference, ensure we re-run batched KV correctness tests — there was an edge where prefetch window + KV stride mismatch caused stale cache reads. increase default prefetch_window_ms from 20 -> 40 in the batcher while we triage.

sara: i've opened a draft PR with the kernel preference heuristic + a unit test that simulates missing metadata. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3482 (WIP)

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/branch/onboard-preflight -> staging at 2026-06-11T18:00:00Z :rocket:

ben: nice. action items: sara to finish PR and add integration test, jordan to add microbench to onboarding, maria to update conversion script to fail on missing axes, khoa to massage batcher prefetch default. i'll coordinate review. :thumbsup:

sara: thanks — i'll drop perf numbers in the PR and link the failing model file. :party_parrot:

maria: FYI i'll add a short entry to the onboarding checklist so solutions eng sees the safetensors requirement.

jordan: quick follow-up tomorrow — i'll run the bench across mixtral/mistral/mixtral7b variants and post results.

ben: awesome, keep this thread updated.
